headline: US consumer confidence at its highest level in almost two years
summary: The consumer confidence index rose to 103.3 points in November from 91.9 in October, its highest level in almost two years.
why: Consumer confidence is a leading gauge of household spending, which makes up most of US economic activity and shapes expectations for corporate earnings.
original_headline: Confianza de consumidores de EU, en su nivel más alto en casi dos años
